acquisition method: For the mass spectrometry, a top-ten data dependent acquisition method was employed
cleavage agent: 10 μL of the cross-linked mixture was digest by the addition of 10 μL trypsin/LysC mix
instrument: Protein digests were analyzed by LC/MS on a Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer
ionization type: The mass spectrometer was equipped with a nanoflex source
labeling: Protein digests were analyzed by LC/MS on a Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer
